title: NativeOntologyImportSummary
description: What a native ontology import would change, counted from one parse of the source. Nothing is persisted.

skipReason.description: Why an RDF statement was left out. NON_PREFERRED_LANGUAGE: another language of a text the import keeps in its preferred language (untagged, then `en`, then the lexicographically first tag). EXTRA_VALUE: a further value of a single-valued field; the import keeps the lexicographically first. UNSUPPORTED_ANNOTATION: an annotation the native model has no field for. UNSUPPORTED_STRUCTURE: a construct the native model cannot represent faithfully, such as a union domain or a SHACL shape. INDIVIDUAL: a statement about a named individual that is not a class or concept. IMPORTS: an `owl:imports` statement; the importer never fetches other documents. UNDECLARED_REFERENCE: a link, such as `rdfs:subPropertyOf`, to a property that neither the source nor the target ontology declares; the definition is kept without the link.

skipGroup.description: RDF statements skipped for one reason and predicate. Blank-node structure hanging off a skipped statement is part of that statement and is not counted separately.

predicate.description: IRI of the skipped statements' predicate. Absent for INDIVIDUAL, which covers every predicate of the individual.

object.description: IRI of the object, set only when the predicate is rdf:type.

subjects.description: A bounded sample of the subjects, the lexicographically first, so the sample is the same on every parse.

skippedStatements.description: What the importer left out of an RDF source because the native model cannot hold it, so a reviewer sees what the preview does not cover. A native export re-imported skips nothing.

total.description: Statements skipped across all groups, including groups omitted from the list.

counts.description: Every parsed concept, property, and axiom is counted once as new, updated, or skipped. `newMappings` counts mappings inside new and updated concepts, so it overlaps the concept counts.

newRelations.description: Parsed axioms the target does not hold yet.

newMappings.description: Concept mappings the target does not hold yet.

skippedDefinitions.description: Parsed concepts and properties identical to the stored ones.

skippedRelations.description: Parsed axioms the target already holds.

detectedFormat.description: Format the server parsed: the requested format, or the detected one when the request omits it.

ontologyLabel.description: Label of the source ontology, when the source declares exactly one ontology header with a label.

items.description: The parsed definitions in the order the source lists them, each with the status applying it would give, at most 5,000 of them. Past that budget ALREADY_EXISTS items are left out first, since nothing can be done with them; `counts` still covers every definition. On a preview against a target each NEW or UPDATE item names its change set operation; a preview against a new ontology has no operations yet.

omittedItems.description: Parsed definitions beyond the listed items.
